scope: Frontend performance, accessibility and presentation; existing booking and payment contracts retained
sourceAlignment: The published assets still implement 65e14cc. Main contains two unbuilt frontend changes: customer_display amount/currency precedence and prebook tolerance 0. This UX release deliberately retains the published supplier amount/currency behavior and tolerance 2, preventing a UI rebuild from activating unrelated business changes.
protectedContracts: Supplier amount and currency selection match the published runtime
Every supplier offer and its contract/hash identity remain available
Checkout total, currency, guest and room payloads are unchanged
Payment idempotency and private status authorization are unchanged
Affiliate and B2B request paths remain separate

reviewHost.purpose: Read-only frontend review; does not start server.js or connect directly to a database

validationBoundary: Mocked browser tests exercise payment/booking states without real orders or charges. Real search/hotelpage/prebook observations are read-only. Lab Lighthouse is not field INP; no unconditional WCAG conformance claim.
